whatItDoes: Add 2 mills to the county’s property-tax rate beginning January 1, 2027, for a dedicated recreation and culture fund. The question estimates $354,692 a year, with actual revenue depending on what the levy raises. Money would develop, improve and maintain new and existing parks and recreation facilities; maintain and improve cultural facilities; and provide new and existing recreation and cultural programs for all ages and abilities. All new revenue and earnings would receive the proposed permanent constitutional and other legal revenue-limit exceptions. The question states no tax end date.
yesMeans: Approve the additional county property tax for the stated facilities and programs, its funding-review process and its revenue-limit exceptions.
noMeans: Do not approve this additional property-tax levy or its proposed revenue-limit exceptions.

parts.label: Who may apply and how spending is reviewed
parts.what: Proposed spending must first go to an advisory board for a recommendation to the county commissioners. Municipalities, school districts and special districts within the county may submit projects or programs for funding consideration. A nonprofit may apply if sponsored by the county or one of those local governments.

parts.label: Published household estimate
parts.what: The question estimates an additional $13.60 a year for each $100,000 of actual residential property value.
